title: Module 26 Review
intro: Fifteen questions across the five lessons, with an organizer, a word-stress item and a dictation. If you miss one, the explanation tells you which lesson to go back to.

items.prompt: The decision has not been taken yet. Choose the best form.
items.text: The search ___ ready for the launch; we'll know on Friday.
items.explain: An open question → a modal hedge. (Lesson 126)

items.wrong: The indexing seems that is the problem.
accept: The indexing seems to be the problem.
It seems that the indexing is the problem.
It seems the indexing is the problem.
items.explain: Subject + *seems to be*, or *it seems that* + clause. (Lesson 126)

items.prompt: Searches took four seconds against a target of two. Choose the honest version.
items.explain: Soften the tone, not the number. (Lesson 126)

items.text: I'm afraid we'll have to pass on it at this ___.
items.explain: *At this stage* limits the no to now: the door stays open. (Lesson 127)

items.wrong: I'd love, but I'm away that weekend.
accept: I'd love to, but I'm away that weekend.
I would love to, but I'm away that weekend.

items.text: I'm afraid I can't ___ the meeting on Friday.
If we ___ at full scale in April, we would have more options now.
items.explain: Mixed conditional: *if* + past perfect, *would* + bare infinitive + *now*. (Lesson 128)

items.prompt: The result is about today. Choose the correct form.
items.text: If we had tested earlier, we ___ in a better position today.
The budget doesn't ___ to extra servers this quarter.
What if we ___ a filter by invoice number?
items.explain: *What if* + past simple: a tentative suggestion. (Lesson 129)

items.wrong: I suggest you to add a filter.
accept: I suggest you add a filter.
I suggest that you add a filter.

items.prompt: The decision has been made. Choose the best form.
items.text: The full search ___ part of the go-live.
items.explain: Hedge the warning and the reason, never the decision. (Lesson 130)

items.prompt: Name the move of each sentence: warning, news, ownership or plan.
rows: I'm afraid I have some disappointing news about the reports page.
Live data will not be available until 15 August.
If we had asked for written confirmation in May, we would have the live data now.
In the meantime, reports will be refreshed every Monday.

items.prompt: Listen and write exactly what you hear.
items.speaker: oliver
items.text: I'm afraid the results weren't quite what we'd hoped, but we can test it again on Thursday.
items.explain: Weak *but* and *can*: «bət-ui-kən-TEST». And *we'd hoped* = *we had hoped*. (Lessons 126 and 128)
items.tts: I'm afraid the results weren't quite what we'd hoped, [but](/bət/) we [can](/kən/) test it again on Thursday.
